verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS API that ships an official CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The Usage API only reports credit and concurrency consumption, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
